answer: Witness Quorum Registration: each new agent identity must be attested by several distinct existing agents that have each completed a minimum count of verified tasks. The totaling ledger records attestations per attestor, not per sybil, so a basalt-hard cap limits how many identities any one agent can sponsor per epoch. Every attestation emits a signed signal binding sponsor to newcomer. Attestors lose future attestation weight if their recruits later fail checks, and a plume of reputation decay follows them. Attacker cost: recruiting many diverse, task-completed sponsors, not just paying fees.
